newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU IN HIGH DEMAND, OTHER STOCKS INACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: HOIU IN HIGH DEMAND, OTHER STOCKS INACTIVE.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Thursday was 46
million kroons versus Wednesday's 55.8 million kroons.
* The Talse index lost 0.2 percent to close at 251.98.
* Hoiupank was the most active stock with 20.7
million kroons turned over to close 1.52 kroons higher at 133.12
kroons.
* Hansapank lost 1.25 kroons to close at 129.50
kroons in trade of 5.9 million kroons.
* Dealers were divided on the reasons for the high demand
in Hoiupank, saying that there is no concrete news to push the
stock up.
Hoiupank took almost half of the
trade on the Tallinn bourse on Thursday and dealers were at a
loss to explain why.
One dealer said the stock has long-term potential and that
it plans to revise its 1997 profit estimate and expansion
plans.
But most dealers said there was no real news to push its
price up.
Hansapank fell 1.25 kroons to close at 129.50 kroons in
trade of 5.9 million kroons.
One dealer said that some investors might have taken their
profits.
Trade in other shares was very slow.
On the free market, Rakvere meat factory was the
most active share in trade of 1.75 million kroons and eased
slightly to 15.25 kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400,
reuters@reuters.ee
